messages:
emma_cs: Weekly health check for AcmeCorp (ACCT-189) — quick error/latency snapshot. Top items: 1) 5xx spike on /v1/generate (last 30m) 2) timeouts on /v1/embeddings 3) rate-limits on /v1/chat during bursts. See bot details below.

ops-bot: [ALERT] 5xx rate increased to 4.7% (baseline 0.8%) for AcmeCorp on us-west-2; top endpoint: /v1/generate

liam_sre: digging in. Initial query from logs:
```
sum(rate(http_server_errors_total{service="inference",account="ACME-189"}[5m])) by (route)
```
Top offenders (last 30m): /v1/generate (3.2k errors), /v1/embeddings (870), /v1/chat (420).

olivia_eng: FYI we pushed model-quant v2.1 to dedicated pool ~45m ago. Rolling back to v2.0 reduced tail latency in staging earlier — suspect quant path causing OOMs on long sequences.

noah_support: saw two tickets from Acme about "requests failing intermittently" + one about high token cost. Customer reported timeouts around 14:10 UTC.

emma_cs: Can we get immediate mitigations and an owner for EOD update? Customer flagged as renewal-risk if this repeats.

liam_sre: Owner: me. Plan: 1) increase pool concurrency for ACME dedicated nodes by 20% 2) enable fallback to smaller model family 3) temp rate-limit smoothing. I'll open an incident if errors >5% for next 15m.

olivia_eng: I'll prepare rollback patch for quant kernels. Quick mitigation config to enable fallback:
```
route_policy {
  account: "ACME-189"
  fallback_model: "redwood-ava-7b"
  thresholds {
    error_rate_percent: 2.0
    timeout_rate_percent: 1.0
  }
}
```
I'll add canary then full switch.

noah_support: I'll draft the customer message and coordinate timing. ETA for update: 2h.

emma_cs: Thanks all. Dashboard link: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/ACME-189/errors?from=-60m
I'll ping @contract-renewal if we need an executive touch.

liam_sre: updating ticket and will post status here every 10m.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from emma_cs, :eyes: from olivia_eng)
